maya: quick design check — compact playground streaming. users report Stop disappears behind the token chip at narrow widths so they cant interrupt. alex: confirmed on small viewports. token chip wraps and pushes the stop button offscreen visually. jordan: proposal: make Stop a persistent left-aligned control in compact rows. move Regen to the right. collapse token count into a tiny pill (dot + number) that expands on hover or keyboard focus. maya: priority is making interrupt discoverable. token detail can be secondary. sam: accessibility note: dont make token info hover-only. it must expand on focus too and have an aria-label like "Tokens used: 34". also add aria-live on streaming container so screen readers get updates for start/stop. kevin: copy tweak suggestion: tooltip -> "Interrupt generation (Esc)" to surface shortcut. pinging @design-bot for wording. design-bot: copy options: - "Interrupt generation (Esc)" - "Stop generating" - "Cancel response" maya: leaning "Interrupt generation (Esc)". explicit and surfaces shortcut. alex: FE note: moving Stop left is easy, but the token expand animation can conflict with token cache indicator. add a small debounce on expand to avoid layout jitter while streaming. jordan: collapsed token idea: a bullet + number like "• 34" that expands to meter on focus/hover; aria-label reads numeric value. keeps width tiny. sam: sample a11y snippet for spec: ```
Streaming…
• 34 ``` kevin: product question: when a user hits Stop, should we leave partial response inline or show an inline banner "Generation stopped — partial response" with a Retry action? Banner should be announced via aria-live. maya: prefer inline banner + Retry so state is explicit. Retry should be keyboard reachable and on the same row. jordan: add analytics: record interrupt timing bucket (pre-first-token, mid-stream, near-end). helps identify if users stop because of quality or length. alex: regen copy note: "Regenerate" is long in compact rail. consider "Regen" or icon-only with aria-label. sam: icon-only OK if focus ring is visible and an accessible name is provided. include keyboard tests. kevin: QA checklist: - compact layout: Stop left + Regen right verified at 320px - token counter accessible via keyboard and hover/focus - aria-live announcements for stream start/stop and for stop banner - Esc shortcut triggers stop and appears in tooltip/copy - analytics events for interrupt timing buckets maya: i'll mock a tiny prototype and post a PR. tagging @jordan @alex for review. jordan: can you drop a figma variation? jordan: will upload two variants by EOD: dot+number and icon-only token. alex: i'll implement debounce on the token expand and verify no overlap with cache indicator. sam: will add voiceover notes and keyboard-focused test cases to the accessibility doc. kevin: small change but should materially reduce interruption friction. :thumbsup: maya: thanks all — will share PR link when ready.
